bypass_log.reason: Nuisance trip per WO-3402 and supervisor Rick's approval (radio, 4:35 PM). Jacket temp trace showed a spike-and-decay (193.8 -> 201 -> back to 133 over 10 min) while U2 discharge temp stayed ~201-207F and matched U1/U3. Sensor suspected; I&E replacement Monday. Bypass time-limited; manual monitoring of U2 jacket and discharge temp every 5 min; will stop U2 manually if jacket temp goes above 195F sustained or discharge temp climbs abnormally. Remove bypass as soon as possible.

work_orders.title: U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP nuisance trips: suspect RTD or loose wiring

notes.text: 11/07: U2 tripped HI_JACKET_TEMP at 201F. Gauge looked normal by the time I got there. Reset and ran.
11/11: Same trip again. Reading jumps up and drops right back in 2-3 min, too fast for real jacket water. Probably the RTD.
11/14: Tripped twice today. Topped off U2 coolant (about 2 gal) while I was there. I&E scheduled Monday to replace the RTD and check wiring.
11/20 day shift: Per Rick, if U2 nuisance-trips tonight it's OK to bypass HI_JACKET_TEMP and keep it running. Watch the temp.

dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP: jacket water indication jumps ~50F in 3 minutes (157->206F) under load while U2 discharge temp stays normal (~188F, matches U1/U3). Repeated nuisance trips per WO-3402. Need field verification of jacket water RTD, wiring and actual coolant level/temp before U2 is restarted. U2 stopped, bypass removed. Ambient 17F, freezing rain.
